summary: Frontend-only testing of Applications page (/applications) with Navigation updates. All features tested and working correctly: Applications page loads with Luminous Precision theme, navigation shows 'Applications' instead of 'Resources', featured Shopfront Signage displays prominently, all 10 industry cards display correctly, inspirations gallery with 22 items loads with filter tags, modal opens on clicking inspiration items, Resources page accessible via footer, and Calculator page has 'All Spec Packs & Resources' link.

features_tested.details: Page loads with 'Luminous Precision' theme - dark background (#050508), cyan accents, glassmorphism cards. Title shows 'APPLICATIONS & INSPIRATIONS'.
'Applications' link visible in main navbar (desktop and mobile). 'Resources' removed from main navigation but still accessible via footer.

Featured application card displays prominently at top with 'Featured Application' badge, Shopfront Signage title, UAE-setting image, product tags (Transparent LED, Indoor Fine Pitch, Outdoor LED), and links to /solutions/retail.

1 featured (Shopfront) + 9 grid cards: Hospitality & Hotels, Retail & Shopping Malls, Corporate & Offices, Healthcare, Transportation & Airports, Entertainment & Cinemas, Sports & Events, Education, Outdoor & Billboards. Each card has UAE-setting AI-generated image, description, product tags, and link to relevant solution page.
Cards correctly link to solution pages. Example: Featured Shopfront -> /solutions/retail, Hospitality -> /solutions/hospitality
Gallery section loads at bottom of page with 22 inspiration items. 'Gallery' label and 'Project Inspirations' heading displayed.
'All' filter and category-specific filter tags present and functional.
Clicking inspiration item opens modal with full image, title ('IMMERSIVE RETAIL EXPERIENCE'), and description. Modal has close button.
/resources page is accessible and displays Resource Library with 28 downloadable resources.
Screen Calculator page (/calculator) has 'All Spec Packs & Resources' link in Related Tools section pointing to /resources.
Mobile menu shows 'APPLICATIONS' link in the bottom section along with 'About Us' and 'Contact Us'.
